summary: Page geometry matches the official 2018 PDF well, but Page 1 Items 5 (TIN), 16, 22, and 24 print blank, Page 2 schedule amounts are left-aligned with border clipping, and Page 1/2 name/address collide with comb ticks.

defects.what: Item 5 TIN prints completely blank on Page 1 even though Page 2 TIN prints 00012345300000.

defects.where: Page 1, Items 16 (Net Taxable Estate), 22 (Tax Payable 1st installment), and 24 (Total Amount Payable)
defects.what: All three key summary boxes print completely blank despite Page 2 Item 40 (85,610,732.29) and Item 20 (3,806,273.97) being computed.

defects.where: Page 1, Items 7, 8, 13 and Page 2 Header (Taxpayer Name)
defects.what: Taxpayer Name and Residence print as plain text colliding with comb ticks; Residence does not wrap cleanly to line 2; Email prints lowercase.
Executor TIN text overlaps the shaded dash separator boxes.

defects.where: Page 2, Part IV (Columns A & B) and Part V (Schedules 1, 1A, 2, 2A, 3, 4, 5)
defects.what: All money amounts in Part IV A/B and Part V schedules are left-aligned instead of right-aligned; Schedule 1A OCT/TCT/CCT No. and Schedule 4 Registered Address clip against cell borders.

defects.where: Part I, Item 10 (Name of Executor/Administrator) and Item 11 (TIN)
defects.what: Long Executor Name scrolls past the left edge inside the input; TIN input segments need clear formatting when filled.

shared_changes_wanted: crates/bir-print: comb-overflow fitting and uppercase formatting for Page 1/2 Name, Residence, and Email
tests_run: Live app capture via just nsh-run-agent linux
open_questions: Note: print-p*.png pages were generated from the running app Print preview sheet.html via headless Chrome + pdftoppm.

blank_item_causes.Item 5 (TIN): No joins in writer-cells.json (left in not_joined because p1c14/p1c15 have 4 slots with slot 0 holding the printed dash, and p1c17 has 0 inputs because 00000 is preprinted). Because p1c13, p1c14, and p1c15 already contain exactly 3 <input> elements each, adding writer-cells.json joins for tinA_1 -> p1c13, tinB_1 -> p1c14, tinC_1 -> p1c15 fills Item 5 cleanly with zero HTML edits.
blank_item_causes.Item 16 (Net Taxable Estate): No money_join in writer-cells.json (left in not_joined because p1c57 has 3 slots with slot 0 holding the printed dot). Because p1c57 already contains exactly 2 <input> elements (s1, s2), adding txtTaxableEstate -> p1c56 + p1c57 to money_joins fills Item 16 cleanly with zero HTML edits.
blank_item_causes.Item 22 (Tax Payable, 1st installment): Already joined in money_joins (p1c88 + p1c90). Printed blank in BEFORE because the synthetic BEFORE payload had Item 21 (117,217,000.00) > Item 20 (3,806,273.97), making Item 22 negative (-113,410,726.03), and bir-print money_joins currently omits negative amounts from comb boxes. With a valid installment portion (1,000,000.00), Item 22 prints 3,706,273.97 cleanly.
blank_item_causes.Item 24 (TOTAL AMOUNT PAYABLE): No money_join in writer-cells.json (left in not_joined because p1c112 is a mixed cell with caption + 11 inputs). Because p1c112 already has 11 <input> elements positioned after the caption and p1c114 has 2 <input> elements, adding txtTotPayable -> p1c112 + p1c114 to money_joins fills Item 24 cleanly with zero HTML edits.

fixed_in_this_commit: Item 5 TIN (tinA_1, tinB_1, tinC_1) now prints in p1c13, p1c14, p1c15 (branch 00000 is preprinted).
Item 16 Net Taxable Estate (txtTaxableEstate) now prints in p1c56 + p1c57.
Item 24 Total Amount Payable (txtTotPayable) now prints in p1c112 + p1c114.
Verified Item 22 (txtTaxPayable_1st) prints cleanly in p1c88 + p1c90 when non-negative.

Re-captured AFTER print-p1.png and print-p2.png from the exact 32,881-byte before.db draft (verified unchanged after print): Item 5 TIN, Item 10 Executor, Item 16 (85,610,732.29), Items 18-21, Part III banks/checks, and all Page 2 Part IV & Schedules 1-5 print cleanly and right-aligned (including Schedule 2 No. of Shares via shared commit 058a0e9b). Item 22/24 remain blank only when Item 21 installment exceeds Item 20 by >=10 digits (negative overflow under C2).
